text: {"assertions":["A race condition in storage/blob/uploader.rs caused partial upload failures when concurrent requests competed for the same key.","The bug's observable symptom was a final part that never received acknowledgment.","The root cause was an unbounded retry loop that lacked backoff.","The fix capped retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter, implemented in PR #1183 on branch fix/partial-upload-1.","The fix was validated by uploading a 40 MB fixture over a throttled network connection.","The error rate improved from 9.2% to under 0.07% (7 per 10,000) after applying the fix."]}
